    tags: [TimeEffect], forbids: [].}
Create enhanced C1 with HMAC-SHA256 digest using FP key. C1 layout (Scheme 0): bytes 0-3: timestamp bytes 4-7: version (non-zero = enhanced) bytes 8-11: pointer to digest offset bytes 12-775: digest area (764 bytes, digest at computed offset) bytes 776-1531: key area (760 bytes) bytes 1532-1535: pointer to DH key offset (unused, zero)
